_comment: VS Code / GitHub Copilot (agent mode) → hosted OmniMind MCP. File: .vscode/mcp.json in the workspace, or the user-level mcp.json via the command 'MCP: Open User Configuration' / 'MCP: Add Server'. One-liner alternative: code --add-mcp '{"name":"omnimind","type":"http","url":"https://omnimind-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer omt_…"}}'. The token is requested once through the `inputs` prompt and kept in VS Code's secret store — never commit a literal omt_ value in a workspace file. Token: BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools. Add '.github/copilot-instructions.md' with 'Start with OmniMind status_get; log decisions with decision_log' for the freshness contract (docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8). Copilot Studio (the enterprise agent builder) rejects SSE servers; this one is Streamable HTTP only, which is fine.

inputs.description: OmniMind personal token (omt_…) from BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools
